newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan public servants on 48-hour strike.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan public servants on 48-hour strike.

text.p: Venezuelan public servants began a 48-hour strike on Wednesday to denounce the government's failure to grant promised wage increases.
The president of the Public Sector Workers Federation (Fedeunep), Carlos Borges, branded the stoppage "a complete success" among the country's 700,000 unionized public servants.

The government said the strike was illegal. It blamed the delay in granting the promised average 65 percent wage increase on technical differences with Fedeunep over the deal reached in February at the end of a long stoppage.
Venezuela has been rocked in the past six months by a series of public sector strikes to protest real wages slashed by years of high inflation to 30 percent of 1980 levels.
